text:
Alex K: kicking off config-only deploy for routing/batching change: cfg-2026-07. canary 5% -> wait 15m -> ramp to 50%. change window 10:30-11:30 PST. applying to us-west-2 first.

Deploy Bot: config-only deploy queued: cfg-2026-07 · targets: routing.policy.v2, batching.max_tokens=512, batching.window_ms=8 · canary=5% · initiated by Alex K · link: https://deploys.redwood.io/cfg-2026-07 · status: started at 2024-11-03T17:44:36Z

Sophie (Eng): quick Q — does this touch KV cache eviction or prefix caching settings? we saw tail latency pressure in last thin-batch test.

Alex K: no kv cache schema change, but batching/window change can increase cold-kv reads per request. watched in staging we had a small p99 blip when window_ms=8.

Leo M: watching metrics now: p50,p95,p99, error-rate, kvcache-miss-rate, kvcache-eviction-rate. will flag if kvcache evictions > 0.5% or p99 increases > 20%

Maria C: suggestion — pin model variant to v2-quant for the canary to reduce memory pressure. command: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API' -d '{"route":"/chat","model":"v2-quant","duration":"1h"}'`

Alex K: good call. pin applied for canary route. canary remains 5%.

Deploy Bot: pin successful for route /chat -> v2-quant · expires in 1h

Oncall Bot: alerting policy set: channel=#oncall · thresholds: p95>300ms for 5m OR error_rate>0.5%

(10m later)

Leo M: seeing kvcache-eviction-rate climb to 0.9% and p99 up ~28% on canary nodes. not observed on control.

Sophie (Eng): dropping canary ramp and holding. what's rollback plan if it keeps rising?

Alex K: hold for now at 5%. if p99 > 25% increase or kvcache eviction > 1% for 5m we rollback to previous config (cfg-2026-06). rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback --config cfg-2026-07 --to cfg-2026-06 --scope canary`

Deploy Bot: canary hold applied · ramp paused at 5% · monitoring window extended

(5m later)

Leo M: condition met — kvcache-eviction-rate 1.2% and sustained p99 +35% over baseline for 6m.

Sophie (Eng): +1 to rollback. also add a quick mitigation: reduce batching.max_tokens to 256 for a soft fix? could reapply after rollback and test.

Maria C: agree. prefer rollback first, then experiment with smaller batch size in a private canary.

Alex K: executing rollback now.

Deploy Bot: rollback started: rolling config back from cfg-2026-07 to cfg-2026-06 on canary targets. initiated by Alex K

Deploy Bot: rollback complete · canary now on cfg-2026-06 · timestamp 2024-11-03T17:50:24Z

Leo M: confirm metrics trending back to baseline. p99 within 3% of control, kvcache-eviction-rate down to 0.2%.

Alex K: thanks all. action items: 1) follow-up test with batching.max_tokens=256 in staging and run kvcache stress test; 2) update the rollout playbook to include pin-to-quant step for config-only batching changes; 3) schedule low-traffic reattempt at 03:00 UTC with 1% canary and longer observation window. I'll create a release note in the config changelog.

Sophie (Eng): noted — I'll add the stress test to the e2e harness and link PR here when ready.

Maria C: adding playbook item now.

Oncall Bot: incident closed — automated rollback executed and metrics stabilized.

Alex K: marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
